limitations: Names and register outputs cannot prove pixel contents or runtime pass selection.
Shader constants are optimized reflection records, not an exhaustive engine state inventory.
Two VCS4 assembly shader files contain no CTAB names; their bytecode intervals and END tokens are validated.
Only unique compiled static records are decompressed; static aliases are fully validated but not decoded twice.
Valve raw LZMA blocks may omit an end-of-stream marker; decoding stops at the stored output length and validates every resulting combination record.
No optical flow, shader modification, memory injection or game file replacement is performed.
